lead: A published resolver is not an installed one, and a child staying `on: "here"` needs the second.
body: `nvs_runtime::script::publish` fills a process-wide slot a worker core reads as it starts, while the publishing thread still compiles through its own thread-local — so a `spawn script` path that falls through to the calling core answers `ResolveError::NoResolver` while the identical placed one succeeds. Wrap the caller in `SharedResolver::scoped`, as `nvs-cli` does for the core it booted on.
